definitions.explanation: A low degree or level of something, especially of an illness, injury, disability, or symptom. Used as a noun and, with の, as a modifier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、{軽度|けいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近視|きんし}→近視：02683_kinshi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{診断|しんだん}→診断：04209_shindan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The exam found that I have mild nearsightedness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{軽度|けいど}のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めれば→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧、⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: If you start treatment while the symptoms are still mild, recovery is faster.

notes:
Composed of {軽|けい} (light) + ⟦{度|ど}→〜度：09845_do⟧ (degree). Most common in medical and clinical contexts. Used attributively with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {軽度|けいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {軽度|けいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧: mild symptoms
- {軽度|けいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{障害|しょうがい}→障害：03228_shougai⟧: a mild disability
- {軽度|けいど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{認知症|にんちしょう}→認知症：04419_ninchishou⟧: mild dementia

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{重度|じゅうど}→重度：28683_juudo⟧: severe (degree)
- {中度|ちゅうど} / {中等度|ちゅうとうど}: moderate (degree)
